name: What should homeowners prepare for before knocking down kitchen walls?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare for before knocking down kitchen walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting an open-concept project, you should examine what runs through your dividing walls. Check for return air vents, baseboard heaters, plumbing stacks from an upper-level bathroom, and electrical switches. You will also need to consider flooring transitions; removing walls reveals gaps in the subfloor where original flooring stops. Determining early whether you want to patch existing flooring or replace the entire level with a continuous material helps establish an accurate scope and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify hidden utilities inside the wall, plan for flooring gaps where the wall stood, and decide on replacement storage solutions before demo starts.
